description: This file contains core patterns and tutorial functions demonstrating uneven sharding with PyTorch's distributed tensor functionalities. It includes functions for creating uneven shards, local integer node arithmetic, and creating distributed tensors with uneven division across processes. The code is designed for testing and tutorial purposes within a distributed PyTorch context.

classes.name: LocalIntNode
classes.description: Class representing integer values distributed across multiple processes, supporting arithmetic operations.

classes.name: LocalTensor
classes.description: Class representing tensors distributed locally with support for shard management.

classes.name: LocalTensorMode
classes.description: Context manager for enabling local tensor operations within a scope.

methods.name: create_uneven_shards()
methods.description: Creates a LocalTensor with different tensor sizes per process/rank to demonstrate uneven sharding.

methods.name: local_int_node_arithmetic()
methods.description: Performs addition and multiplication on LocalIntNode instances to demonstrate local integer operations.

methods.name: dtensor_uneven_sharding(world_size: int = 3)
methods.description: Creates a distributed tensor with unevenly divisible dimensions across processes, testing tensor distribution and reconstruction.
